description: This file defines an Android activity demonstrating the use of LayoutTransition and property animations for adding/removing views with transition effects, including custom animations.

classes.name: LayoutAnimations
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating layout transition animations with UI controls.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, buttons, checkboxes, and configures transition animations.

methods.name: setupTransition
methods.description: Configures the LayoutTransition's animator settings based on checkbox states.

methods.name: createCustomAnimations
methods.description: Creates custom property animations for different transition scenarios.
